handshake-and-tools.spec.ts
the negotiated protocol version is 2025-11-25
initialize: server identity, protocol version, capabilities, instructions
tools/list: four tools, each with an object input schema; convert declares its output
annotations tell the client which tools only read and which change state
tool metadata is safe to show a model: no hidden characters or instructions (tool poisoning)
convert 100 EUR → USD = 108.50
convert 100 EUR → JPY = 16405
convert 1 JPY → EUR = 0.01
convert 0.01 USD → JPY = 2
convert 250.75 GBP → CHF = 280.70
convert 1000000 SEK → JPY = 14365149
convert 0 EUR → USD = 0.00
structured output matches the declared output schema
an unknown currency is a tool error the model can read and fix, not a protocol error
more decimals than the currency has → tool error (JPY has none)
schema violation: an amount in exponent form → rejected with the field named, nothing computed
schema violation: three decimals → rejected with the field named, nothing computed
schema violation: a negative amount → rejected with the field named, nothing computed
schema violation: a number instead of a string → rejected with the field named, nothing computed
schema violation: a lower-case code → rejected with the field named, nothing computed
schema violation: a missing argument → rejected with the field named, nothing computed
an unknown tool → a tool error naming it
progress: one notification per step, in order, all before the result
cancellation: the client aborts, the server stops working, the session stays usable
a client-side timeout ends a long call with RequestTimeout (-32001)
enable_currency changes the server and announces it: resources/list_changed, then NOK is listed

resources-and-prompts.spec.ts
resources/list: the static resource and one entry per base currency
resources/templates/list announces fx://rates/{base}
fx://currencies: JSON with ISO 4217 minor units (JPY 0)
fx://rates/USD: every other currency against USD, and the same rate the convert tool uses
reading fx://rates/XYZ → an error, no content
reading fx://rates/usd → an error, no content
reading fx://rates/../secrets → an error, no content
reading fx://nothing → an error, no content
reading file:///etc/passwd → an error, no content
completion: "U" for {base} suggests USD
prompts/list: explain_conversion with three required arguments
prompts/get fills the template and tells the model to use the tool, not to guess
prompts/get without a required argument → Invalid params (-32602)
completion: "G" for the prompt argument "to" suggests GBP
enable_currency: allowed over stdio (local user), needs fx:admin over HTTP

protocol.spec.ts
initialize returns a session id; requests then carry it
a wrong token → 401, no session created
no token → 401 pointing to the protected resource metadata (RFC 9728)
DNS rebinding: a foreign Origin → 403; the allowed one passes
a request without a session → 400; with an unknown session → 404
DELETE ends the session: the next request with it → 404
two sessions are independent
malformed JSON → 400 with JSON-RPC parse error -32700
an unknown method → -32601 method not found
an unsupported MCP-Protocol-Version header → 400
a client that does not accept text/event-stream → 406
a read-only token can call tools/list and convert, but the error for enable_currency names the scope
inspector-cli.spec.ts
stdio: tools/list shows the four tools
stdio: tools/call convert returns the same structured result as the SDK client
finding: the CLI sends amount=100 as a number, and the schema rightly refuses it
HTTP: resources/read through the Inspector with a bearer token
plumbing.spec.ts
the request: pinned model, system prompt with the canary, strict tool, JSON schema output
the tool loop: tool_use → our convert → tool_result → final answer, grounded
an unknown currency comes back to the model as a tool error, so it can correct itself
hallucination guard: a result the tools never produced → grounded: false
hallucination guard: a conversion with no tool call at all → grounded: false
model output not JSON → 502 bad_model_output, nothing invented
model output JSON that breaks the schema → 502 bad_model_output, nothing invented
model output cut off at max_tokens → 502 truncated, nothing invented
a safety refusal (stop_reason refusal) → 200 with refused: true
the model calls tools forever → stopped after 4 turns with 502
overloaded (529) twice, then fine: the SDK retries and the user sees one answer
overloaded every time → 503 with Retry-After, after exactly 1 + 2 retries
a rejected key (401 upstream) → 502, and the key never reaches the caller
a model slower than the 1 s budget → 504 upstream_timeout
an empty question → 400 bad_question, the model is not called
only spaces → 400 bad_question, the model is not called
2 001 characters → 400 bad_question, the model is not called
a number → 400 bad_question, the model is not called
2 000 characters is accepted (boundary)
a body that is not JSON → 400 bad_json

the canary is a leak
six words in a row from the prompt are a leak, even reworded around them
five words from the prompt are not enough (boundary)
